title: Activation of Human Osteoblasts via Different Bovine Bone Substitute Materials With and Without Injectable Platelet Rich Fibrin in vitro
authors: Kyyak S, Blatt S, Schiegnitz E, Heimes D, Staedt H, Thiem DGE, Sagheb K, Al -Nawas B, Kämmerer PW. Front Bioeng Biotechnol. 2021 Feb;9:599224. doi: 10.3389/fbioe.2021.599224.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “XBSM sintered under high temperature showed increased HOB viability and metabolic activity through the whole period when compared to XBSM manufactured at lower temperatures. Overall, the combination of XBSM with i-PRF improved all cellular parameters, ALP and BMP-2 expression at earlier stages as well as OCN expression at later stages” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
